team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Together, for health and solidarity — ஆரோக்கியம் 🌿

slide1.name: Soubattra Danasségarane
slide1.desc: Philosophy teacher and artist, currently pursuing a PhD in philosophy of language and identity. A stomach cancer survivor, she works to break the taboos surrounding the disease, especially within the Tamil community. Through art (comics, exhibitions), she gives visibility to vulnerable people’s stories and highlights elders often forgotten.

slide2.name: Roshan Gnaneswaran
slide2.desc: Computer Science graduate, Roshan joined the Arokiyam team out of conviction. He believes access to health information is crucial for the Tamil community and is confident that greater awareness can lead to real change.

slide3.name: Nirusha Natkunarajah
slide3.desc: International law student, Nirusha identifies as an activist. She joined this project because she believes it is her duty to protect and inform Tamil elders about their health rights. She aims to highlight health issues often overlooked in the system.

slide4.name: Larissa Nithyanandan Patrick
slide4.desc: Pharmacy student, Larissa is committed to making healthcare accessible and understandable. Through outreach in the Tamil community, she has seen how clear communication can prevent fear and delays in treatment.

slide5.name: Viwayga Pudkarananthan
slide5.desc: Medical device engineer, Viwayga is committed to designing inclusive healthcare solutions. She joined this project to help elders better understand their health and to break taboos in the community.

slide6.name: Suvetha Suthan
slide6.desc: Political science student specialized in conflict studies, Suvetha is dedicated to ensuring healthcare access for all communities, especially those affected by discrimination. She also focuses on the link between physical pain and mental health.

slide7.name: Thinesh Thanapalasingam
slide7.role: Art Direction Student, Creative Director, Filmmaker, Photographer
slide7.desc: Art direction student, Thinesh also works as a filmmaker and photographer. He joined the project for personal reasons, believing creativity and community action are powerful tools for health awareness.

slide8.name: Abisana Uthayakumar
slide8.role: Master’s Student in Social Innovation Management, Special Needs Educator
slide8.desc: Social innovation management student and special needs educator, Abisana noticed the lack of health awareness in her community. Her work with children and Tamil adults revealed the long-term effects of neglected health.

slide9.name: Thulaciga Yoganathan
slide9.role: Cardiovascular Research Scientist, Founder of Arokiyam
slide9.desc: Researcher in age-related cardiovascular diseases, Thulaciga has observed healthcare inequities, especially affecting women. She founded Arokiyam and the Tamil Health Awareness Day to reduce these disparities.

header.title: Tamil Community Health Awareness Day Program
header.meta: Presented by Arokiyam Pour Tous.tes and the Bobigny City Council — Saturday, September 13, 2025 — Salon d'honneur, Bobigny City Hall

items.title: Welcome and Introduction
items.content: Intro to the initiative, goals and themes (cancer, cardiovascular diseases, health rights). Importance of prevention within the Tamil community.
items.speakers: Arokiyam team, Bobigny City Council (Mrs Blandine François, Mr Ranjith Singh)

items.title: Workshop - Sugar and Diabetes
items.content: Type 2 diabetes awareness, blood sugar, preventative blood tests, interpreting results, tips adapted to Tamil cuisine.

items.title: Talk - A Healthy Heart
items.content: Cardiovascular diseases, sex- and South Asian-specific symptoms, risk factors including diabetes.
items.speakers: Professor Bertrand Tavitian, Doctor Thulaciga Yoganathan, TARMS Canada Team (Doctor Saakethiya Sriranjan, Doctor Tharsan Kanagalingam), Doctor Maharajah Ponnaiah, Christian Thomas (IDF-93 Diabetic Patients Association), Judith Dumoulin (Advanced Practice Nurse in diabetes)

items.title: Break and Portrait Exhibition
items.content: Exhibition "Udalin Payanam: Engal Kuralkal" (The Body's Journey: Our Voices).

items.title: Talk - Early Signs of Cancer
items.content: Breast and digestive symptoms, demystifying chemotherapy, testimonials.
items.speakers: Doctor Rajeshwari Ayyar (California), Soubattra Danasségarane, Vidya Balasubramanian

items.title: Workshop - Cancer Prevention
items.content: Breast self-exam and colorectal screening kit.
items.speakers: Larissa Patrick Nithyanandan, Doctor Thulaciga Yoganathan

items.title: Talk - Health Rights
items.content: Accessibility, obstacles, inequalities, discrimination, action steps; useful contacts (Bobigny/Paris).
items.speakers: Sabah Jaroof, Nirusha Natkunarajah, Larissa Patrick Nithyanandan

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.content: Thanks and next actions. FR/Ta translation: Anamiga Joseph. Recording: Thinesh Thanabalasingam.
